title: SARS-CoV-2 wastewater sequencing data
description: This is the SARS-CoV-2 wastewater surveillance genomic data from Gwangju, South Korea, conducted by the Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA).We compared the performance across multiple sequencing platforms and analyzed contemporaneous clinical specimens to evaluate the utility of wastewater-based surveillance for detecting viral variants.
center: Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency
samples: SARS-CoV-2: wastewater surveillance sample from wastewater metagenome
Isolated from a wastewater treatment plant located in Gwangju, South Korea.
